items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: I wanted to ask you about Slim Leftwich.

ctx.x: invited him to my house and damn for you didn't sell me a Baldwin grand piano while I was there. I'll never forget Bendix saying that. Told me that right in front of Blaise D'Antoni. Parties, people that were at the... This is with Connie Haynes and Reitman. There were some mighty nice things going on there then. And yet, some very, very unhappy feelings sometimes with bananas.
